QueryCdsPrices.storageType: CDS disk storage type, including SSD_Enhanced (Enhanced SSD), cloud_hp1 (General Purpose SSD), hp1 (High Performance Cloud Disk), and hdd (General Purpose HDD). Default is hp1.
QueryCdsPrices.storageType.hdd: General Purpose HDD (this type is being gradually phased out)
QueryCdsPrices.storageType.sata: Previous-generation cloud disk, dedicated to creating DCC sub-instances
QueryCdsPrices.storageType.local_ssd: Data stored on local SSD disk, with lower latency and better IO and throughput, suitable for medium to large relational database workloads
QueryCdsPrices.storageType.local_hdd 或 std1: Local HDD disk, suitable for large-scale data storage scenarios
QueryCdsPrices.storageType.local_nvme 或 nvme: Local NVME disk, data stored on local NVME SSD disk, ultra-high performance, suitable for latency-sensitive workloads
QueryCdsPrices.paymentTiming: Payment method, including Postpaid and Prepaid.
QueryCdsPrices.purchaseCount: Total price for any number of CDS disks, must be an integer greater than 0, optional parameter, defaults to 1
